content: C2SP tlog-checkpoint (signed note), tlog-witness (add-checkpoint with consistency proof; witness keeps latest checkpoint per origin, returns timestamped cosignature), tlog-tiles. Trillian Tessera is a Go library (GA) implementing tlog-tiles with POSIX backend. golang.org/x/mod/sumdb/tlog provides RFC6962-style Merkle hashing, inclusion/consistency proofs, tiles; sumdb/note provides signed notes.
